notes: Both question particles carry a written *whether* under rule 17 (`הֲ` at t022, `אִם` at t027), while the intervening `אוֹ` and waw take the two written *or*s under rule 14. No correlative pair falls to a single morpheme here, since a distinct interrogative morpheme stands before each *whether* — rule 14's own carve-out for a morpheme that is itself what the opening correlative says.

`אֵי־זֶה` → *which* and `כְּאֶחָד` → *alike* each meet rule 30's one-English-word condition and are headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme; every other morpheme in the verse has an English word of its own.

`שְׁנֵיהֶם` writes no *of*, so the construct numeral takes *both* and the suffix takes *they* under rules 18 and 19; the verbless clause's supplied *shall be* joins the predicate `טוֹבִים`, discontinuous around *alike* under rule 25.
Both preposition + assimilated-article pairs are split under rule 12; all 33 source and 33 target IDs are covered exactly once.
